title: Brazilian Bread Pudding
description: A rich and sweet dessert made with bread, inspired by traditional Brazilian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Bread
ingredients.amount: 2 cups, stale and torn into 1-inch pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, combine bread, Brazilian sweet, and flaky pastry.
In a separate bowl, whisk egg, sugar, and heavy cream.
Pour the wet ingredients over the bread mixture and mix well.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
